title: Shane Ryan MBE Appointed CEO of The Phoenix Community Trust
description: The Phoenix Community Trust today announced the appointment of Shane Ryan MBE as its first Chief Executive Officer, marking a pivotal moment in the organisation's next chapter.
body: The Phoenix Community Trust (TPCT) today announced the appointment of Shane Ryan MBE as its first Chief Executive Officer, marking a pivotal moment as the organisation steps into its next chapter as an independent, community-led institution.

The Phoenix Community Trust is a newly established organisation working in racial justice, community power and social change. Operating at the intersection of grassroots community infrastructure and the philanthropic landscape, with a national footprint across nine regions in England, it exists to dismantle structural racism and end funding inequity by consolidating, resourcing and reinforcing the collective power, capacity and infrastructure of Global Majority communities across the UK.

The newly independent organisation was awarded £50m from The National Lottery Community Fund in November 2024, combining capacity building, direct financial investment, and infrastructure development for the Global Majority and Black, Racialised and Minoritised (BRM) VCSE sector.

As Chief Executive Officer, Ryan will lead the organisation's strategic direction, building the team, partnerships and operational foundations needed to establish TPCT as a lasting institution for the sector.

Ryan brings a wealth of expertise in social justice, strategic planning and community development, drawing on more than 25 years' experience in the sector. Prior to this appointment he led TPCT's transition team, and developed the Phoenix Fund, which catalysed the organisation TPCT is today.

Previously Ryan - who was awarded an MBE in the 2023 New Year Honours List for his services to young people and charity - served as Senior Adviser to The National Lottery Community Fund, Global Executive Director of the Avast Foundation, Deputy Director at The National Lottery Community Fund, and multi-award-winning CEO of Working with Men (Future Men).

A dedicated campaigner for justice and social reform, his work also includes serving as Strategic Consultant to the Grenfell Response Unit, in addition to being a regular speaker, adviser and author on ethical leadership, positive masculinity, community engagement, and diversity, equity and inclusion.

Shane Ryan MBE, CEO of The Phoenix Community Trust, said: "Six years ago, alongside 30 organisations, we set out with a vision. Today, watching that vision take shape is more than I could have hoped for. To lead this next chapter is a huge honour and responsibility - I welcome the challenge, whilst acknowledging those that paved the way for us to get to this stage. Our goal is bold: a permanent, independent institution built to last. My appointment isn't the destination, just one more step towards it."

Amna Abdullatif, Chair of the Board of Trustees, said: "We are delighted to welcome Shane Ryan MBE into the role of CEO. Shane has been part of the Phoenix journey for many years, and brings with him a wealth of knowledge, community partnerships and lived commitment to tackling structural racism in philanthropy. His leadership will be instrumental as we build Phoenix into a lasting force for community power and racial justice. The Board looks forward to working with him as we begin this next chapter."
